description: An opaque cream long-sleeved undertunic and burgundy ankle-length outer tunic or coat have broad gold woven borders at the neckline, sleeves, center edges, and hems. A burgundy cloak fastens at one shoulder with a round clasp and drapes down one side. A decorated belt with round medallions and a long patterned hanging tab is worn at the waist. Brown ankle boots are visible beneath the layered hem.
